# Sito (Carlos Andrés Mora González)

> Portfolio of Sito, a fullstack developer who designs and builds web and mobile products, from the first sketch to production. Based in Barcelona.

The site is a single page per language. Sections: about, what I do, stack, projects (career stages) and contact.

- [Portfolio (English)](https://sito8943.com/en/): about, stack, projects and contact
- [Portfolio (Español)](https://sito8943.com/es/): la misma web en español

## Career

- Inmersoft (Jun 2021 — Oct 2023, Santiago de Cuba): fullstack developer. [Descubre Trinidad](https://descubretrinidad.com), [Inmersoft](https://inmersoft.net/)
- AOShield (Oct 2023 — Feb 2026, Canada, remote): fullstack developer on client platforms (under NDA)
- Harbour.Space (Sep 2025 — present, Barcelona): fullstack developer. [Harbour.Space](https://harbour.space/)

## Own products (Sito Universe)

- [Sito Wallet](https://wallet.sito8943.com/): personal finance, on web and mobile
- [Sito Notas](https://notas.sito8943.com/): quick, private notes that also work offline
